params.description: If present, object is a form object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable reference.

params.name: object
params.description: Form object name (if * is passed) or variable reference (if * is omitted), designating the target list box.

params.name: numColumn
params.description: Number of columns to set as static, starting from the first column on the left.

overloads.semanticRole: Sets the first numColumn columns of the designated list box as static (they cannot be moved within the list box).

constraints: Static columns and locked columns (LISTBOX SET LOCKED COLUMNS) are two independent features.
